title: Unique Smoky Australian Shrimp Skewers
description: A cultured and creamy Australian dish featuring Thai chilli jam, reduced to perfection and grilled to a smoky finish on a robata grill, this recipe is a show-off dish that combines the best of Australian and Thai flavors, with a macrobiotic-friendly twist.
instructions: Preheat the robata grill to medium-high heat, about 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together coconut milk, Thai chilli jam, lemon juice, olive oil, garlic, ginger, salt, and black pepper.
Add the shrimp to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade, letting it sit for at least 10 minutes.
Thread the marinated shrimp onto skewers, leaving a small space between each shrimp.
Brush the grill with olive oil to prevent sticking and grill the shrimp for 2-3 minutes per side, or until pink and cooked through.
Let the shrimp rest for a few minutes before serving, garnished with fresh cilantro and a side of steamed vegetables.
Reduce the remaining marinade by cooking it over low heat for a few minutes, stirring constantly, until it thickens into a creamy sauce.
Serve the shrimp with the reduced sauce spooned over the top.
